name: Analyze Reusable Workflow

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      os:
        required: true
        type: string
      arch:
        required: true
        type: string
      package-type:
        required: true
        type: string
      powershell-version:
        required: true
        type: string
      is-preview:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
      build-configuration:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: 'Release'

jobs:
  analyze-packaging:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.os }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Install dependencies for Mariner
        if: contains(inputs.os, 'mariner')
        run: |
          sudo dnf install -y azurelinux-repos-extended
          sudo dnf install -y dpkg

      - name: Install dependencies for Ubuntu/Debian
        if: contains(inputs.os, 'ubuntu') || contains(inputs.os, 'debian')
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y dpkg

      - name: Build PowerShell
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "./build.ps1 -Configuration '${{ inputs.build-configuration }}' -Architecture '${{ inputs.arch }}'"

      - name: Generate DEB Package (Native)
        if: inputs.package-type == 'deb'
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "./tools/packaging/packaging.psm1 -Action Build -PackageType DEB -Architecture '${{ inputs.arch }}' -Version '${{ inputs.powershell-version }}' -IsPreview ${{ inputs.is-preview }}"

      - name: Validate DEB Package
        if: inputs.package-type == 'deb'
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "Invoke-Pester -Path ./test/packaging/linux/package-validation.tests.ps1 -Output Detailed"

      - name: Generate RPM Package
        if: inputs.package-type == 'rpm'
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "./tools/packaging/packaging.psm1 -Action Build -PackageType RPM -Architecture '${{ inputs.arch }}' -Version '${{ inputs.powershell-version }}' -IsPreview ${{ inputs.is-preview }}"

      - name: Generate Tar.Gz Package
        if: inputs.package-type == 'tar.gz'
        run: |
          pwsh -Command "./tools/packaging/packaging.psm1 -Action Build -PackageType TarGz -Architecture '${{ inputs.arch }}' -Version '${{ inputs.powershell-version }}' -IsPreview ${{ inputs.is-preview }}"

      - name: Upload Package Artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: powershell-${{ inputs.package-type }}-${{ inputs.arch }}
          path: |
            dist/*.deb
            dist/*.rpm
            dist/*.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7
